Title: View Account Balance and Transaction History
Description: Users must be able to view their current balance and a paginated history of transactions for any of their linked accounts.
Acceptance Criteria: Balance updates in real time; Transactions paginated at 25 per page; Each transaction shows date, amount, merchant, and running balance; Exportable to CSV

Title: Transfer Funds Between Accounts
Description: Users must be able to transfer funds between their own accounts (checking to savings and vice versa) with immediate effect.
Acceptance Criteria: Transfer form requires source account, destination account, amount, and optional memo; Insufficient funds shows a clear error; Transfer confirmation screen shown before submission; Transaction appears in history within 30 seconds

Title: Account Statement Download
Description: Users must be able to download monthly account statements as PDF files for any account going back 24 months.
Acceptance Criteria: Statement download available for past 24 months; PDF is generated within 10 seconds; Statement includes bank logo, account number (masked), period, and all transactions
